name: Bacula-Server
description: Bacula is a network Client/Server based backup program. This app contains also Baculum, web environment to easy manage with the Bacula programs. If You do not havy any postgresql server, You could chose sqlite3 version, but this version is not recomended. Please check ReadMe before You start. Default Tag is 11 sqlite3 version.

paths.name: Bacula storage path
paths.description: Path where backups will be stored on Host disk

paths.name: Bacula working directory
paths.description: Path where sqlite3 db will be stored

paths.name: Bacula log path
paths.description: Path where bacula's logs will be stored on Host disk

paths.name: Apache log path
paths.description: Path where webserver logs will be stored

paths.name: Baculum config
paths.description: Path where WEB Interface configuration will be stored

variables.name: IP Address
variables.description: If You set bridge network, You should type in Unraid Host IP Address. This IP is sending to clients, which could connect to storage server using this IP

variables.name: Email Recipient
variables.description: Email Recipient, You can delete this variable if You do not want to send bacula messages

variables.name: SMTP Host
variables.description: Your email provider SMTP Server IP/Host, You can delete this variable if You do not want to send bacula messages

variables.name: SMTP Port
variables.description: Your email provider SMTP Port, You can delete this variable if You do not want to send bacula messages

variables.name: Email Username (sender)
variables.description: Email sender login, You can delete this variable if You do not want to send bacula messages

variables.name: Email User Password (sender)
variables.description: Email User's password, You can delete this variable if You do not want to send bacula messages
